data.title: What is Blog Writing?
data.subtitle: Blog writing means creating valuable content that answers your audience's questions and positions your brand as an industry leader. We combine SEO expertise with storytelling to produce blogs that perform.

steps.title: Discovery Call
steps.text: We learn your business, audience, competitors, and content goals. This shapes every article we write for you.

steps.title: Content Calendar
steps.text: We build a monthly topic calendar aligned with your SEO strategy and business objectives. You approve topics before we write.

steps.title: Writing and Editing
steps.text: Your dedicated writer researches, writes, and our editorial team reviews. You get polished, publish-ready articles.

steps.title: Publish and Measure
steps.text: Articles publish on your schedule. We track performance and adjust strategy based on what ranks and converts.

paragraphs: A blog stops working the moment it becomes something you owe. The posts get shorter, the gaps get longer, and the archive turns into a record of the months you had time rather than a case for why anyone would buy from you.

Handing the blog to one writer who stays on your account changes what the archive becomes. That writer carries the context from the last post into the next one, so the library builds an argument over a year rather than restating an introduction twelve times.

items.question: How many blog posts do I get per month?
items.answer: Our standard plans include 4-8 articles per month, but we scale up to 16+ for clients who need aggressive content velocity. We recommend starting with 4 per month and increasing as you see results.

items.question: How much do blog writing services cost?
items.answer: Blog writing runs on a monthly plan set by how many articles you want and how long they run. One conversation is enough to scope it, and you get the number before you commit to anything.

items.question: Do I get the same writer every time?
items.answer: Yes. Every client is assigned a dedicated writer who learns your brand voice and industry. Consistency in voice builds reader trust and brand recognition.

items.question: How long are the blog posts?
items.answer: Most articles are 800-1,500 words, depending on the topic and SEO requirements. We write to the length each topic needs.

items.question: Can I request revisions?
items.answer: Yes. Every article includes revisions until you're satisfied. We'd rather get it right than publish something that doesn't represent your brand.
